text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT PAGE: High-severity quality regression detected for tenant AcmeCorp on dedicated-pool-us-west-2-acmecorp. Alert: automated evals show >35% drop in response fidelity vs baseline. Paging oncall.

sara (serving-oncall): I'm on it. Seeing the same failed-eval spikes on the model: redwood-open-7b--v2@q4_0 which we rolled out in the pool at 09:12 UTC. Can someone confirm recent quant profile change?

mike (eng-ml): I deployed a new quant profile (q4_0_aggressive) to the dedicated pools for latency wins at 09:11. It got pushed via canary that then widened after green checks.

jordan (support): AcmeCorp support reported increased hallucinations in customer-prod yesterday via ticket #ACME-1921, correlates with 09:15 UTC. Customer impact: several requests returned wrong named entities.

sara (serving-oncall): Ok likely culprit = aggressive quantization. Quick triage: is this isolated to AcmeCorp's dedicated pool or broader? alex, can you check model variance across pools?

alex (infra): Checking metrics... dedicated-pool-us-west-2-acmecorp shows p90 perplexity +48% and rouge drop. Other dedicated pools: stable. Hosted multi-tenant nodes: no regression. So it's isolated to that tenant's pool where the profile was applied.

mike (eng-ml): Confirmed. The deployment pipeline targeted the tenant pool due to a config override; we missed the override flag during promotion. My mistake.

sara (serving-oncall): Cool — isolation helps. Immediate mitigation plan: 1) Revert quant profile in AcmeCorp pool to previous profile (q4_0_precise) 2) Reroute incoming traffic to canary node if revert takes time 3) Communicate to customer. Any objections?

nisha (customer-sre): Please include customer-facing language for the update. They need ETA for fix and whether data was impacted.

sara (serving-oncall): No objections. I'm going to run the revert command now in prod-managed control plane. Will do a canary test after revert.

sara (serving-oncall): Running: ```redwoodctl pools update --tenant acmecorp --pool dedicated-pool-us-west-2-acmecorp --quant-profile q4_0_precise --reason "rollback regression"```

sara (serving-oncall): CLI returned 202 acceptance. K8s rolling restart underway for that pool subset (graceful, 3 at a time). Watching logs.

alex (infra): Logs show worker nodes draining, new pods scheduled with q4_0_precise. Need ~2.5 minutes per pod; estimated 8 minutes to reach full service.

incident-bot: ACTION: Oncall handoff scheduled to mike in 30 minutes if still open.

mike (eng-ml): I'll shadow and be ready for rollback to the previous model ver if revert isn't sufficient. Also prepare a hotfix build to pin quant profile on promotion pipelines.

jordan (support): Drafting customer message: "We detected a model-quality regression in your dedicated inference pool after a quantization profile update. Our team is rolling back the profile; we expect restoration within ~10 minutes. No customer data exposure. We'll follow up with root cause and preventive actions." Want to add anything?

nisha (customer-sre): Add "we will run a targeted validation pass on a set of your production prompts and share results." and a contact link to our incident SRE queue.

jordan (support): Updated message included. Sending to AcmeCorp CS contact now.

sara (serving-oncall): Canary validation starting against 5 representative prompts from ACME testset. Sending sample diff: ```- Q: "Who is the account manager for AcmeCorp?"
- Before (q4_0_aggressive): "John Doe - Sales" (incorrect)
- After (q4_0_precise canary): "Alicia Park - Enterprise Sales" (matches expected)```

mike (eng-ml): Good sign. Running aggregate evals on 2000 prompt sample — initial batch shows quality metrics back to baseline within noise.

alex (infra): Pod readiness 80%. Traffic shifting back to pool nodes. No error surge.

incident-bot: NOTE: Postmortem task assigned to @mike, @sara, and @alex.

sara (serving-oncall): I'm going to leave a short-term mitigation checklist: 
- pin quant profile for acmecorp pools to q4_0_precise
- block pipeline promotions that target tenant pools without explicit override confirmation
- run a targeted eval job nightly for 48h on AcmeCorp testset
- notify account team and set up follow-up call

mike (eng-ml): I'll add a CI gate that fails promotions if eval delta > 5% on curated prompt sets. Also will revert the promotion bot rule that widened canary automatically.

nisha (customer-sre): AcmeCorp acked the message and appreciates the fast rollback. They've asked for a short RCA and a timeline for the permanent fix.

sara (serving-oncall): Good. No data exfiltration concerns per logs. Ticketing: creating internal incident ticket and setting Sev2.

support-bot: Ticket created: INC-ACME-2410001, linked to platform incident.

alex (infra): Final check: CPU/GPU utilization stable. Latency unchanged. Regressions metrics normalized.

sara (serving-oncall): I'm going to mark this thread as mitigated once we have 30m of stable metrics and customer confirmation. If anything new appears ping me directly.

mike (eng-ml): Follow-ups for postmortem: root cause = accidental promotion of q4_0_aggressive to tenant pool; fix = CI gate + promotion promptset validation + stricter override flags. I'll own the code changes.

nisha (customer-sre): I'll schedule a 1:1 with AcmeCorp for 30-min review tomorrow and share the RCA draft.

jordan (support): Noted. Closing customer-facing loop after RCA.

sara (serving-oncall): Handoff: I'm out in 20m. @mike you'll be oncall owner after that. Please escalate to eng-platform if the rollback doesn't hold.

mike (eng-ml): Got it — will take over. Thanks everyone.

incident-bot: RESOLUTION: Mitigation applied (quant profile revert). Monitoring window started. Will auto-close if no new alerts in 30m.

sara (serving-oncall): Closing note before handoff: temporary mitigation = revert quant profile; long-term = CI/promote changes + nightly evals + explicit tenant-target checks. Action owners: mike (code fixes), alex (deployment safety), nisha (customer comms), jordan (support follow-up).

mike (eng-ml): Ack. I'll update the postmortem template and assign tasks.

nisha (customer-sre): AcmeCorp confirmed restored quality on their end. Thanks team.

sara (serving-oncall): Marking as mitigated. Leaving thread to mike for follow-through.

support-bot: Incident INC-ACME-2410001 status -> mitigated.

mike (eng-ml): (afterhand) I'll run a rehearsal of the rollback procedure in staging to make sure the command path is < 5 minutes next time and update runbook.
